I opened the app and it's working — clean, clear, and it does what we set out to build. The "Add bookmark" action is right there, there's a friendly starting state before anything is saved, and your report confirms the flows I care about all check out: saving a link and finding it again after a reload, opening it without losing my place, the warning when I try to save the same address twice, searching and filtering by a tag, editing, and deleting with a confirmation. It also fails safely so my collection isn't lost if something goes wrong.

This does what I wanted for saving and managing my bookmarks. I'm happy to accept it.
